name: Batch Transfer Response V 04
definition: The BatchTransferResponse message is sent by any party to any party (acquirer, agent or issuer) in response to a BatchTransferInitiation message.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Information related to the management of the protocol.

BatchIdentification.name: Batch Identification
BatchIdentification.definition: Identification of a batch.|All the messages included within the batch will have the same batch identification value.

OriginalBatchIdentification.name: Original Batch Identification
OriginalBatchIdentification.definition: Identification of the original batch to answer.|Mandatory when the batch response has not the same identification as the batch initiation.

NumberOfMessages.name: Number Of Messages
NumberOfMessages.definition: Number of messages.||For a start of a collection, this is the number of expected messages in the collection if known. This is also the last expected message sequence number in the collection.||For a start of a batch, this is the number of expected messages in the batch if known. This is also the last expected message sequence number in the batch.||For a start of a batch acknowledgement, this is the maximum number of messages that can be received in the batch.||For an intermediate acknowledgement, this is the last message sequence number received in sequence.||For an intermediate checkpoint, this is the message sequence number of the last received message.||For an end of batch this is the last message sequence number sent in the closing batch, equal to the number of messages sent in the batch.||For an end of batch acknowledgement, this is the last sequence number received in the sequence.

BatchChecksum.name: Batch Checksum
BatchChecksum.definition: Checksum of the series of messages received in the batch or until a checkpoint.

RequestAcknowledgement.name: Request Acknowledgement
RequestAcknowledgement.definition: Indicator to request acknowledgement.|True: Acknowledgement requested|False: Acknowledgement not requested.

Programme.name: Programme
Programme.definition: Programme, network, or brand processes the transaction.

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response)

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: A reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.

ClearingBatchData.name: Clearing Batch Data
ClearingBatchData.definition: Clearing data at batch level allowing clearing in different currencies.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Contains information that identifies or is specific to a transaction jurisdiction.

SettlementService.name: Settlement Service
SettlementService.definition: Type of settlement service for specific services requiring settlement.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Identification of the reconciliation period between the acquirer and the issuer or their respective agents.

OriginalResponseCode.name: Original Response Code
OriginalResponseCode.definition: Original Response code defined in ISO 8583.

ProtectedData.name: Protected Data
ProtectedData.definition: Contains protected data and the attributes used to protect the data.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.

SecurityTrailer.name: Security Trailer
SecurityTrailer.definition: Trailer of the message containing a MAC
